rows.title: Game genre
rows.desc: Tunes the picture for the kind of game. Each genre keeps its own stabilizer settings.

rows.title: Prevent input delay
rows.desc: Standard cuts input lag for the kind of content; Boost cuts it further by matching the console's frame rate.

rows.title: VRR & G-Sync
rows.desc: Lets the TV follow the frame rate a console or PC sends, so motion stays smooth without tearing.

rows.title: AMD FreeSync Premium
rows.desc: The same for AMD graphics cards and consoles that use FreeSync.

rows.title: ALLM
rows.desc: Switches the TV to its low-latency game mode by itself when a connected device starts a game.

rows.title: Dark room mode
rows.desc: Lowers the brightness for playing in a dark room.

rows.title: Black stabilizer
rows.desc: Lifts dark areas so detail in shadows is easier to see.

rows.title: White stabilizer
rows.desc: Tames bright areas so detail in highlights is easier to see.

rows.title: AI Game Sound
rows.desc: Sets the sound for the game being played: effects, clear voices and surround.
